remarks: Immaculate home that is light and bright with an open floor and nicely updated. Living room with hardwood floors, Eat in kitchen with white cabinets and stainless steel appliances. There is a sunroom/ dining room off the kitchen with the door down to the patio. The 3 bedrooms upstairs all have hardwood floors. There is a nicely updated bath. The walk out lower level has a spacious family room with a wood burning stove & sliders to the large covered patio with a built in grill. The 4th bedroom has barn doors to the family room. An updated bath and laundry room complete this part of the home. There is an in-law that is accessible from the outside or the garage. Lovely flat back yard that is fenced in along with a shed and green house. Newer central air, gas heat and 3 full baths are a few more features of this wonderful home in Springdale on a cul-de-sac street. Walk to the Springdale train station, shops and restaurants.  Super convenient location close to the Merrit Parkway and 5 minutes from New Canaan.
